Context: 10. Authorization of Pension and Gratuity

All assessed Government dues should be deducted from the provisional gratuity. The payment of provisional pension should not continue beyond six months from the date of retirement. Within this period, the Accounts Officer will determine the final pension / gratuity and issue PPO, authorize the Head of Office for payment of the difference, if any, in the amount of gratuity.
